Measuring electrification from space

Do satellite images of light at night show who has electricity? Each region compares the share of people living under detectable light with the share of households that a national survey found have electricity. Hover over a region for the numbers.

Most recent survey per country: Kenya 2022, Tanzania 2022, Uganda 2024-25 (MIS), Rwanda 2019-20, DR Congo 2023-24. Light: VIIRS annual composites (EOG). Population: WorldPop. Preliminary results.
